# Inline Hover Swap

You can also reveal alternate text inline inside paragraphs:

* **Term 1:** Hover over <span class="hover-text" data-hover="a type of software container">Docker</span> for a definition.
* **Term 2:** Hover over <span class="hover-text" data-hover="JavaScript syntax extension">JSX</span> for a explanation.
